title: Labatec
description: labatecpharma.com Revenue $19 Million Labatec S.A. is a Swiss laboratory instruments company founded in 1965 in Meyrin, Geneva, manufacturing and distributing high-precision analytical equipment for chemistry, biotech, pharma and energy sectors across 100 plus countries. Its three divisions cover Labatec Instruments for analytical and sample preparation equipment, Labatec Pharma for GMP quality control solutions and Labatec Energy for oil and gas testing systems. With offices in Geneva, Zurich and Dubai Jebel Ali Free Zone, it partners with major global brands including Metrohm, Anton Paar, Mettler Toledo, Agilent and Thermo Fisher. The company holds ISO 9001, ISO 17025 calibration and ISO 13485 medical device certifications. Its product range spans titrators, spectrometers, chromatographs, pH meters, mills, centrifuges and industrial fuel analyzers. It serves customers from small labs to multinational pharmaceutical and petrochemical corporations.
